What’s new

Find out what is new in Event Streams version 12.0.x.

Release 12.0.2

UI support for enabling tiered storage

Event Streams 12.0.2 includes support for enabling tiered storage when creating a topic by using the Event Streams UI.

For more information, see the instructions for enabling tiered storage in creating topics.

Support for Kubernetes 1.33

Event Streams version 12.0.2 introduces support for Kubernetes platforms version 1.33 that support the Red Hat Universal Base Images (UBI) containers.

Deprecation of support for Confluent-compatible Schema Registry API version 6

Support for version 6 of the Confluent-compatible Schema Registry API is deprecated and has been replaced by version 7. Version 6 support will be removed in a future release of Event Streams.

You can continue to use version 6 of the API with Event Streams 12.0.2 and earlier, but to maintain compatibility with future releases of Event Streams, it is recommended that you update your Kafka producer and consumer applications to use version 7 of the Confluent-compatible Schema Registry API.

Security and bug fixes

Event Streams release 12.0.2 contain security and bug fixes.

Release 12.0.1

Tiered storage support for Kafka topics

Event Streams version 12.0.1 introduces support for tiered storage for Kafka topics. This feature offloads historical topic data to remote storage, reducing storage requirements of local disks and improving cost efficiency.

Apicurio version updated to 2.6.13.Final

Event Streams 12.0.1 includes Apicurio Registry version 2.6.13.Final for managing schemas. Ensure all applications connecting to your instance of Event Streams that use the schema registry are using Apicurio client libraries version 2.5.0 or later before upgrading to Event Streams 12.0.1. For more information, see prerequisites.

Deprecation of support for Apicurio Registry Core REST API version 1

Support for version 1 of the Apicurio Registry Core REST API is deprecated and has been replaced by version 2. Version 1 support will be removed in Apicurio Registry v3.x, which will be adopted in a future release of Event Streams.

You can continue to use version 1 of the API with Event Streams 12.0.1 and earlier, but it is recommended that you:

  • Migrate to version 2 of the API to ensure continued compatibility with future releases of Event Streams.

  • Upgrade all client dependencies to the latest available 2.x versions.

For guidance about API usage and migration, see the Apicurio Registry documentation.

Security and bug fixes

Event Streams release 12.0.1 contains security and bug fixes.

Release 12.0.0

Kafka version upgraded to 4.0.0

Event Streams version 12.0.0 includes Kafka release 4.0.0, and supports the use of all Kafka interfaces.

Kafka 4.0.0 introduces several significant improvements and includes updates to the Kafka APIs that might require changes to existing Kafka client, streaming, and Connect applications. Review the notable changes in Kafka 4.0.0 carefully, and plan your upgrade of existing deployments to avoid any impact on your Kafka applications.

Java version and Kafka client updates

Event Streams version 12.0.0 introduces changes to Java version requirements and client compatibility. Ensure that your applications are using supported Java versions and client libraries.

Collection of usage metrics

To improve product features, performance, and technical support, Event Streams 12.0.0 and later collects data about the usage of deployments by default. Data is collected about all Event Streams instances.

You can disable data collection at any time.

Support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.19

Event Streams version 12.0.0 introduces support for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.19.

Security and bug fixes

Event Streams release 12.0.0 contains security and bug fixes.
